# MeiHeadLoader { #timetoalign.loader.MeiHeadLoader }

```python
loader.MeiHeadLoader(seed=None)
```

Read an MEI header and state what it says as statements.

MEI 5.1 headers are read, and MEI 4.0.1 headers using ``workList`` and
``manifestationList``. ``load`` takes one MEI file whose root is ``mei``
or ``meiHead``; :meth:`create_bundle` states its description on a new
bundle or on one given.

## Examples {.doc-section .doc-section-examples}

```python
>>> from timetoalign.loader.metadata import MeiHeadLoader
>>> MeiHeadLoader().create_bundle()
Traceback (most recent call last):
...
ValueError: MeiHeadLoader holds no source: load an MEI file first.
```

## Methods

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| [clear](#timetoalign.loader.MeiHeadLoader.clear) | Release the header and the source. |
| [create_bundle](#timetoalign.loader.MeiHeadLoader.create_bundle) | State the header's description on a bundle and its timelines. |

### clear { #timetoalign.loader.MeiHeadLoader.clear }

```python
loader.MeiHeadLoader.clear()
```

Release the header and the source.

### create_bundle { #timetoalign.loader.MeiHeadLoader.create_bundle }

```python
loader.MeiHeadLoader.create_bundle(
    into=None,
    subjects=None,
    id=None,
    base=None,
    stated_by=LIBRARY_AGENT,
    date=None,
)
```

State the header's description on a bundle and its timelines.

The work becomes a value node under the bundle's ``schema:about``,
each manifestation a new graphical timeline in millimetres of
unknown length, named by its first title; expressions and items are
value nodes. A name without an IRI is offered as a candidate. A
pair a subject already states or holds an entry of (a candidate, a
pair someone believes) is passed over, and the pairs of a value node
go into it only while the subject states it, so importing a header
twice into one bundle adds nothing and every belief recorded
stands. The import holds no belief. Every pair
is checked before the bundle changes: a refused one leaves it as it
was.

#### Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name      | Type                                                                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | Default         |
|-----------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------|---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|
| into      | [AlignmentBundle](`timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentBundle`) \| None         | The bundle to state the description on, returned; a new bundle when None.                                                                                                                                                                   | `None`          |
| subjects  | [Mapping](`collections.abc.Mapping`)\[[str](`str`), [str](`str`)\] \| None | Maps the ``xml:id`` of a manifestation or an item to the ID of a timeline (at any depth) or region of *into*, which then takes that entity's statements in place of a new timeline or value node.                                           | `None`          |
| id        | [str](`str`) \| None                                                       | The ID of the new bundle; when None, one minted by the loader's minter (``bundle_…``), which the manifest writes: the bundle's statements need a subject that is not a blank node. The new bundle's ``name`` is the file's stem either way. | `None`          |
| base      | [str](`str`) \| None                                                       | The MEI file's address: relative targets resolve against it, and every basis and IRI built from an ``xml:id`` begins with it. The file name, percent-encoded, when None.                                                                    | `None`          |
| stated_by | [str](`str`) \| [Sequence](`collections.abc.Sequence`)\[[str](`str`)\]     | Who states the pairs: an IRI, or several.                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `LIBRARY_AGENT` |
| date      | [str](`str`) \| [datetime](`datetime`).[date](`datetime.date`) \| None     | The day of the provenance entries, ``YYYY-MM-DD`` or a :class:`datetime.date`; today when None.                                                                                                                                             | `None`          |

#### Returns {.doc-section .doc-section-returns}

| Name   | Type                                                       | Description                        |
|--------|------------------------------------------------------------|------------------------------------|
|        | [AlignmentBundle](`timetoalign.alignment.AlignmentBundle`) | The bundle holding the statements. |

#### Raises {.doc-section .doc-section-raises}

| Name   | Type                       | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
|--------|----------------------------|----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|
|        | [ValueError](`ValueError`) | Before anything changes, if *id* is given with *into*, *subjects* without *into*, a key of *subjects* names no work, expression, manifestation or item, or names a work or an expression, a value names no timeline or region of *into*, the header holds more than one work, a work or an expression has no ``xml:id``, or a pair is refused (``the prefix 'doi' is declared neither by the catalogue nor on the new timeline of manifestation 'source_2'``). |
